name: Murrieta Youth Advisory Committee
org: City of Murrieta Community Services Department
what_you_do: Be the teen voice for the city. You plan youth events and community drives, learn how city government works, and pick up job readiness skills and volunteer hours.
who_can_apply: Teens who live in the City of Murrieta and are in 9th to 12th grade at a Murrieta Valley Unified School District school. You need two references.
duration: Eight months, October to May; one meeting a month, on the first Tuesday at 6:00 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 round took applications July 14 to Sep 11, 2026, with interviews Sep 22 and the first meeting Oct 6, 2026. 2027-28 dates are not posted. Past rounds opened in July or August.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application with five short answers and two references. Turn it in at the Murrieta Youth Center (40644 California Oaks Rd) or email it to EOrr@MurrietaCA.gov. Questions: Youth Center at (951) 461-6105.
notes: Members must go to all mandatory city events. One member also serves on the Parks and Recreation Commission. Dates come from the city's 2026-27 information sheet.
